paragraphs: “In the name of Rabbi Bivi” — so Seder HaDorot cites from Midrash Tehillim 110. The text Hyman uses there reads Rabbi Yehudah HaKohen bar Avin, and Buber’s reads Rabbi Huna HaKohen bar Avin.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Midrash Tehillim 110:1 fully names Rabbi Yehudah HaKohen bar Avin reporting Rabbi Bivi. This supports the reading Hyman calls “our version.” His Seder HaDorot quotation and Buber’s reported Huna reading have not been independently collated here; his fully written Rav heading is retained without silently replacing it by the passage’s Rabbi title.
